verdicts.reason: Both are letterboxed: the 600x200 banner sits in a strip across the middle of the square, with roughly two thirds of the canvas left as blank white bands above and below, so neither one rearranges the design for the new shape. A blows the dark text card up to nearly the full width, which leaves it almost touching the left and right edges and buries the patterned artwork, so only thin slivers peek out and the brand look is mostly lost (its text is the more readable of the two). B is just a shrunk copy of the original that keeps the artwork and its balance, but the headline is small at this canvas size; it wins only on staying faithful to the original.
